question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'because'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a conjunction to show the reason why no one can be expelled. 
 
• Off the given options only **because **is a conjunction while the other words can be used as **preposition **or adverb.
 
• When we use because, we are focusing on the reason: *She spoke quietly **because **she didn't want Ratna to hear.*
 
• From the above it is clear that because is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

Complete passage__ - *The contract (1) __between__ the author and the reader is a game. And the game is one of the greatest inventions (2) __of__ Western civilisation: the game of telling stories, inventing characters and creating the (3) __imaginary__ paradise of the individual, from whence no one can be expelled (4) __because__, in a novel, no one owns the truth and everyone has the right to be (5) __heard__ and understood.*
